Strategy: Square-root pairing preference. Score each bin by the square-root distance between its residual and twice the item size, preferring a leftover gap near that target. The choice differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest fit leaves a residual far from twice the item while a looser bin leaves a gap near it. It may help by creating reusable same-size gaps with gentler penalties far from the target, but may fail if future items differ greatly in size.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs(sqrt(r) - sqrt(2 * item)) for r in bins]
```
